arm: Completed 5m close at least 2% in favour of the close-price entry. Trailing distance 2% of best completed close, rounded outwards to study tick. Effective next bar. Keep original wick as initial stop.
horizon: Original 72h or continuous data end. Independent, single-position admission per arm; accept only entry strictly after prior exit close and alphabetic ties. Periods start flat.
cost: taker 5bp per fill on traded notional, plus 10bp per market leg on entry notional, no funding, unlevered
control: Frozen no-target/initial-wick-stop Nautilus trades. Reuse their fills if no tighter stop can be installed before their exit. Otherwise find earlier native stop fills with the established VectorBT first_hit kernel and account for them using Portfolio.from_orders.
grid: One arm and one distance specified before comparing, no search.
